GPTR-F-002-S88.title: Token Schema and Storage Contract
GPTR-F-002-S88.description: Define and implement the persistent schema for bearer tokens including fields for token_id, hashed_token, created_at, expires_at, rotated_from, rotated_to, and revoked_at. Ensure compatibility with existing MongoDB patterns and GPTReader access constraints.
GPTR-F-002-S88.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; Code/Shared/brain_auth.py; GAP: No formal token lifecycle schema currently defined

GPTR-F-002-S89.title: Token Expiration Enforcement
GPTR-F-002-S89.description: Implement expiration logic to invalidate tokens based on expires_at timestamp. Ensure expired tokens are rejected at authentication time and cannot be used for GPTReader access.
GPTR-F-002-S89.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: Expiration not enforced beyond basic validation

GPTR-F-002-S90.title: Token Rotation Chain Logic
GPTR-F-002-S90.description: Implement rotation mechanism that issues a new token while linking it to the prior token via rotated_from/rotated_to fields. Ensure only the latest token in a chain is valid and prior tokens are invalidated.
GPTR-F-002-S90.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: No rotation chaining or lineage tracking exists

GPTR-F-002-S91.title: Token Lifecycle Audit Logging
GPTR-F-002-S91.description: Add audit logging for all token lifecycle events including creation, rotation, expiration, and revocation. Logs must include timestamp, actor, and token_id, and integrate with existing debug/audit logging patterns.
GPTR-F-002-S91.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py; GAP: No dedicated token lifecycle audit trail exists
